02 / Twice-weekly edit

THIS WEEK,
BEYOND THE OBVIOUS

Three free or unusually good-value London events, selected for access, local character and a story worth following.

01 Free

Sat 19 Sept · 17:00–21:00

HELLO EARTH at Crossness Pumping Station

Artists, ecologists and local groups launch a new Bexley programme inside the Victorian “Cathedral of Sewage”, with talks, films, music, children’s workshops and rare station tours.

Where
Crossness Pumping Station, Bexley
Access
Booking required
Check details ↗
02 Free

Sun 20 Sept · 13:30–16:00

Costermongers’ Pearly Harvest Festival

London’s Pearly Kings and Queens gather in button-covered finery for maypole and Morris dancing, Cockney songs and a procession from Guildhall Yard to St Mary-le-Bow.

Where
Guildhall Yard, City of London
Access
Drop in
Check details ↗
03 Free

Fri 18 Sept · 11:00–18:00

Reviving Craft at Somerset House

More than 70 artists trace China’s living craft heritage through ceramics, glass, textiles, jewellery, furniture and immersive digital work in the South Wing galleries.

Where
Somerset House, Embankment Galleries South Wing, Westminster
Access
Drop in
Check details ↗
